root_cause.text: A null pointer dereference occurs in the `setup_backlight_device` function because the code accesses the `ext_caps` member of the backlight capabilities structure without verifying its validity for LVDS connectors that do not support extended backlight capabilities.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/amdgpu_dm/amdgpu_dm.c` to add a null check (`caps->ext_caps &&`) before accessing `caps->ext_caps->bits.oled`, aligning with the CVE description stating "LVDS connectors don't have extended backlight caps so check if the pointer is valid before accessing it."
